This is an open-ended technical creative generation task — writing a custom UDF (User-Defined Function) in C for ANSYS Fluent from scratch, with specific geometry logic, deformation handling, and per-iteration execution. Petrel scores higher on Creative Generation (85.9 vs 83.4) and on the public benchmarks (GPQA Diamond 64.8 vs 62.5, Arena-Hard 90.2 vs 89.1), suggesting stronger performance on novel, inventive coding tasks requiring domain reasoning. The warm, well-specified request is fine for either model, but the generative coding challenge favors Petrel.
